Transport Documents

डिलीवरी ऑर्डर

An official instruction from the carrier or freight forwarder authorizing the release of cargo to the named consignee or agent at the destination.

Quick answer: An official instruction from the carrier or freight forwarder authorizing the release of cargo to the named consignee or agent at the destination.

Quick answer

An official instruction from the carrier or freight forwarder authorizing the release of cargo to the named consignee or agent at the destination.

Why it matters

डिलीवरी ऑर्डर matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

An official instruction from the carrier or freight forwarder authorizing the release of cargo to the named consignee or agent at the destination.

Operational example

The consignee submitted the delivery order at the terminal to claim their container after customs clearance.
